g.text: Coarse output rounding can hide or inflate the same underlying noise
4096 independent records per point; error bars: pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals.
Constant tone; 1 s window, 0.5 ns iid edge jitter, random clock phase, 200 MHz quantization.
The nanoHz and floating traces overlap. This timing model is not a physical bench test.
